facts: Constitution 1.1.0 (specs/constitution.md, approval specs/constitution.approval.json) is adopted for this change.
A feature is a task entity with metadata.kind 'feature'; stage, stage_source, stage_set_at and pull_requests live in metadata, so no migration is needed.
updateEntity (src/services/entity-service.ts:302) checks the version, merges metadata shallowly, bumps the version and writes an 'update' audit row; content is unchanged, so no re-embedding happens.
createTask and updateTask (src/services/task-service.ts:132-228) pass merged metadata straight to storeEntity/updateEntity without any feature handling today.
The repositories table (migration 018) holds remote and release_on_merge; normalizeRemote in src/util/git-remote.ts produces its keys.
Decision D1 (Ivo, 2026-10-31): a workspace report never writes entities, so linking a plain task does not apply feature defaults; data-model.md report step 4 is updated accordingly.
